snippet.title: Penguins!
snippet.description:
~Love Games? Subscribe and click the Bell to get notified of new game releases every day!

Join Ace the Penguin in 80+ levels of penguin-puzzle fun in the casual game Penguins! Escape zoo keepers as you make your way through eight different zoo zones.

You can try the game for free here: 
http://www.wildtangent.com/Games/penguins
